hook: *13,000* JEE aspirants sign up for a third Advanced attempt
tldr: An online petition asking for a third JEE Advanced 2027 attempt has 13,000 signatures.

beats.what: Petition seeks a third attempt, or two attempts spread over three straight years.
beats.why: Students say two attempts in a row disadvantage those also finishing regular school.
beats.care: No official change yet. Plan for the current two-attempt rule.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: JEE aspirants have started an online petition for a third attempt at JEE Advanced 2027. They argue the current two-attempt limit puts students in regular schooling at a disadvantage. The petition also offers an alternative: two attempts allowed over three consecutive years. It has 13,000 signatures, per Telangana Today. No response from the IITs was reported.

cards.title: 🧠 The rule today
cards.body: JEE Advanced, the IIT entrance exam, can be taken at most twice, in two consecutive years.

cards.q: How many signatures does the third-attempt petition have?

insight: The petition says the two-attempt limit hurts students in regular schooling.
watch: Any response from the organising IIT.
